name: Shilling
facts: Fund I, Founders Fund, Opportunity Fund
position: Shilling backs early winners in the Portuguese ecosystem and stays with them as they grow, now including a €50M Opportunity Fund for growth-stage rounds. It's a generalist, with a portfolio spanning AI, fintech, health, consumer and web3, and a large network of founders around the firm.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your portfolio is the densest map of Portuguese startups I know, and a dozen of them, from Aptivio and Assimetria to Replai, Anybrain and Coverflex, sit right on top of what I've built.
summary: Shilling's companies are Portuguese-founded and increasingly AI-native, and many are at the stage where a first senior PM or a proper revenue stack makes the difference. That's my job: nine years in tech across B2B and B2C SaaS, from KYC and bot detection at 14M-user scale to customer ops on a New York ad platform. Revenue-intelligence, fraud, ad-tech and fintech companies in your portfolio match my background almost one to one, and I can work with them from Lisbon, freelance or full-time.

reasons.title: Fraud, identity and fintech
reasons.body: I scaled KYC at Pi Network from about 1M to 14M+ users, with bot detection and silent bans. That's the daily problem at Anybrain, Fraudio, Student Finance and Coverflex.

reasons.title: Revenue and ad tech, from the inside
reasons.body: Aptivio, Replai and Framedrop sell into growth and revenue teams. I've been one: CS ops and growth reporting at Vibe.co, and the start of Pi Network's ad network.

reasons.title: AI-native, shipped for real
reasons.body: Assimetria, Equall, tl;dv, Talka and Bitskout live or die on LLM quality. I've shipped LLM features with evaluation sets and production guardrails.

vc_notes.thesis: Generalist, but heavy on AI, SaaS and fintech, where my overlap is strongest.
vc_notes.stage: Early rounds plus a growth Opportunity Fund: seed to Series C covered.
vc_notes.platform: A large network of founders and operators around the firm.
